sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Traffic signals, signs and work zones
Every knowledge statement for Traffic signals, signs and work zones is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
Dark-signal instructions are kept exactly within the source’s reduce-speed and prepare-to-yield scope. Red-turn permissions retain the full-stop, sign and arrow restrictions. No generic signal rule replaces a specific arrow rule.
Illustrated signal combinations and image-dependent sign or flagger mappings have not been visually checked. Caption meanings can support textual facts, but they do not establish the missing association with an unseen symbol.
Open source limitation (verify DE-SIGNALS-DIAGRAMS): The complex-signal combinations, several sign illustrations and flagger poses depend on images. This text-only pass cannot validate those image-to-meaning mappings; visual source review is required before shipping visual-recognition practice.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
